h000:hrif.value: An ordinary resident of the estate with an extraordinary will to catch the last train. Balanced clip, sturdy constitution. Starts with rations from the kopitiam.

h001:hrif.value: Certis-trained and calm under pressure. The biggest clip and the hardest hits, with spare clips on the belt. The horde remembers its own.

h002:hrif.value: An SCDF paramedic who never clocked out. Small clip, but their Wet Bandages cure infection at ANY health, and they carry two from the start.

h003:hrif.value: Keeps the estate running: fixes substations in HALF the time and starts with a generator part and a barricade kit.

n000:hpea.value: Was halfway through his kopi-o when the sirens started. Zombies that catch him will add him to their number — corpses rise after a few seconds unless burned.

n001:hpea.value: Refused to leave the shop. Every civilian still breathing when the train departs is worth score — every one that falls feeds the horde.

n002:hpea.value: Knows every shortcut on the park connector. The horde knows them too, now.

u000:ugho.value: A neighbour, once. Slow, relentless, and every hit spreads the slow-burn infection. Kill-XP shared in a crowd falls off 25% per extra zombie — the horde grows smarter apart.

u001:ugho.value: Dried out by the long walk from the columbarium end of the estate. Tougher than he looks.

u002:ugho.value: It still remembers its morning runs. Fast enough to catch a reloading survivor in the open.

u003:ugho.value: An auxiliary officer who held the line too long. Riot gear still turns aside small-arms fire.

u004:ugho.value: A survivor risen with their wits half-intact — a defected player's avatar, played AGAINST the living.

u005:uabo.value: The brain of the outbreak, nested in the kampong remnant off Lorong Buangkok. Kill it and the horde dies with it — the estate's other way out.

h010:htow.value: Ten storeys of homes over a void deck. The lifts stopped on Tuesday.

h011:htow.value: The newer point block. Somebody is still hanging laundry on the sixth floor.

h012:htow.value: North-South line, platform B. The board still reads: LAST TRAIN 12:00.

h013:hhou.value: A Town Council substation. STAND in the yard to repair it -- progress keeps, a hit costs 3 seconds. All three live and the station doors will open.

h014:htow.value: Fifty stalls, zero queues. The best scavenging in the estate, and the worst sightlines.

h015:htow.value: Stand inside the clinic grounds a few seconds and trained hands will flush the infection out of you.

h016:hhou.value: Crossed planks and sandbags. It will not hold forever — it only has to hold long enough.

h017:hgtw.value: A technician's field rig on a tripod. Fires its own 40-round belt dry, then stands inert.

h018:hhou.value: A brood nest. Burn it (Molotov) or smash it: each nest down permanently trims the horde’s growth and pays XP.

h019:hhou.value: A span of the North-South line viaduct, marching toward the depot.

h01A:htow.value: Six cars, headlights on, doors open. "Last train leaving. Please mind the platform gap."

h01B:htow.value: Platform B. The yellow line is a suggestion now.

n020:ncop.value: Somebody left in a hurry. Stand close a moment to rummage it -- or smash it open and let the whole district hear.

n021:ncop.value: One man's trash is one survivor's pipe. Searchable: stand close and type -search.

n022:ncop.value: Town Council padlock, long since bolt-cut. Searchable: stand close and type -search.

n023:ncop.value: Forms in triplicate, and sometimes wire. Searchable: stand close and type -search.

n024:ncop.value: The chicken rice is gone. The kerosene stove is not. Searchable: stand close and type -search.

n025:ncop.value: Doors open, hazards blinking, boot full of possibilities. Searchable: stand close and type -search.

n026:ncop.value: A provision-shop delivery van, still half loaded. Searchable: stand close and type -search.

n027:ncop.value: Nobody is answering 995. The parts still work. Searchable: stand close and type -search.

n029:ncop.value: Service 265 is not coming. The timetable glass makes a decent blade. Searchable: stand close and type -search.

n028:ncop.value: A sodium lamp on the estate grid. The pools of light are where you count your bullets.

h01C:htow.value: Twenty-seven storeys of corridor lights still burning. Nobody answers the intercom.

h01D:htow.value: Repainted last spring in Kebun Baru mint. The paint outlived the town council.

h01E:htow.value: The peach one. Aunties still argue over whose floor dried laundry fastest.

h01F:htow.value: Sky-blue bands over the void deck. The mynahs kept nesting in the lift motor room.

h01G:htow.value: Lavender trim, fresh from the upgrading works nobody will finish now.

h01H:ngme.value: The towkay never closed. Sells tools for CLIPS (lumber): Barricade Kit (2), Mobile Phone (3), Wet Bandage (2), Flare (1). Ammo-vs-tools is the trade.

h01I:hhou.value: Sharpened pipe and wire. Anything that claws it gets clawed back.

h01J:hhou.value: An oil drum fire: a pool of light, a little vision, and something like courage.

h01K:hhou.value: The floor's distribution board. Stand at it a few seconds to flip the breaker -- light for the whole floor, and a hum the stairwell can hear.

h01L:hhou.value: Somebody's kitchen radio, volume knob snapped off at maximum. Everything walking wants it to stop.

n02A:ncop.value: The sheets are still rumpled from the last sleep anyone got here. Stand close a moment to rummage it -- or smash it and let the whole block hear.

n02B:ncop.value: One door hangs ajar on the dark inside. Stand close a moment to rummage it -- or smash it open and let the whole block hear.

n02C:ncop.value: The wok is still on the ring and the kerosene is under the sink. Stand close a moment to rummage it -- or smash it and let the whole block hear.

n02D:ncop.value: The set died mid-broadcast; the standby light never blinked off. Stand close a moment to rummage it -- or smash it and let the whole block hear.

n02E:ncop.value: The joss sticks burned down hours ago; the candles have not. Stand close a moment to rummage it -- quietly, if you can.
